# Fig 1

```{r warning=FALSE,  fig.width=6, fig.height=12}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(reshape2)
library(patchwork)
count_values <- function(x) {
    c('positive' = sum(x > 0), 'negative' = sum(x < 0))
}
load("data/RDA2_betas.RData")
support_old = support
load("data/RDA2_betas_for_debi.RData")
support = append(support_old, support)
plots <- list()
for(model_name in names(support)){
data <- as.data.frame(support[[model_name]])

freq_df <- as.data.frame(apply(data, 2, count_values)) / nrow(data)
colnames(freq_df) <- 1:ncol(data)
freq_df <- freq_df %>% t  %>% melt 


plots[[model_name]] <- ggplot(freq_df, aes(x = Var1, y = value, fill = Var2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  # geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype="dashed", color = "black") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,1.0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("positive" = "#FC8D62", "negative" = "#66C2A5"),name="Sign") +
  # scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Sign of Beta",breaks=c("positive","negative"),labels=c("Positive","Negative")) +
  labs(title = ifelse(model_name=='CoDA','Coda',model_name), y = "Selection Frequency",x="genus") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 18),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 17),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 17),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20)
  ) 
if (model_name != "Debi")
  plots[[model_name]] <- plots[[model_name]] + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),axis.title.x = element_blank())
}



# plots[[1]] + plots[[2]] + plots[[3]] + plots[[4]] + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
p_all = plots[[1]] / plots[[2]] / plots[[3]] / plots[[4]]   / plots[[5]] + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
# Save the plot
ggsave(filename = "pic/Freq_plot_y1_all.png", plot = p_all, width = 10, height = 12.5)
```

# ROC plot annotated

## ROC plot annotated S1

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggsci)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

# --- Helper: trapezoidal AUC on (FPR, TPR) ---
auc_trapz <- function(fpr, tpr) {
  # keep finite & in [0,1]
  ok <- is.finite(fpr) & is.finite(tpr)
  fpr <- pmin(pmax(fpr[ok], 0), 1)
  tpr <- pmin(pmax(tpr[ok], 0), 1)

  # add (0,0) and (1,1) if missing
  if (!any(abs(fpr - 0) < 1e-12)) {
    fpr <- c(0, fpr); tpr <- c(0, tpr)
  }
  if (!any(abs(fpr - 1) < 1e-12)) {
    fpr <- c(fpr, 1); tpr <- c(tpr, 1)
  }

  # sort by FPR; deduplicate FPR by keeping the max TPR at ties
  ord <- order(fpr, tpr, decreasing = c(FALSE, TRUE))
  fpr <- fpr[ord]; tpr <- tpr[ord]
  d <- dplyr::tibble(fpr=fpr, tpr=tpr) |>
    dplyr::group_by(fpr) |>
    dplyr::summarise(tpr = max(tpr), .groups="drop")

  # trapezoids
  f <- d$fpr; t <- d$tpr
  sum(diff(f) * (head(t, -1) + tail(t, 1)) / 2)
}

# --- Read & parse (your parsing kept) ---
data <- read.csv("data/ROC_S1.csv")

data <- data |>
  mutate(
    FPR_mean = as.numeric(gsub("\\(.*\\)", "", FPR)),
    FPR_std  = as.numeric(str_extract(FPR, "\\((.*?)\\)") |> gsub("\\(|\\)", "", x = _)),
    TPR_mean = as.numeric(gsub("\\(.*\\)", "", TPR)),
    TPR_std  = as.numeric(str_extract(TPR, "\\((.*?)\\)") |> gsub("\\(|\\)", "", x = _)),
    tau      = as.numeric(tau)
  )

# --- Compute AUC per model ---
# Compute AUC per model (same as before)
auc_tbl <- data |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(ROC_AUC = auc_trapz(FPR_mean, TPR_mean), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(ROC_AUC))

# Format the text to display
auc_text <- paste0("ROC-AUC values: \n",
                   paste0(auc_tbl$model, ": ", sprintf("%.3f", auc_tbl$ROC_AUC), collapse = "\n"))

# Base ROC plot (with no legend)
p1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = FPR_mean, y = TPR_mean, color = model)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_npg(name = "Model") +
  labs(x = "False Positive Rate", y = "True Positive Rate", title = "ROC Plot for Scenario 1") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", # remove legend
        legend.title   = element_text(size = 14)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = 1, yend = 1), color = "#252525", linetype = "dashed")


# Add the AUC box inside the plot (bottom right)
library(grid)  # for unit()

# Build pretty annotation text
auc_text <- paste0(" AUC values: \n",   # bold title (markdown-like if you use ggtext)
                   paste0(auc_tbl$model, ": ", sprintf("%.3f", auc_tbl$ROC_AUC), collapse = "\n"))

# If you want bold support, use element_markdown in theme (from ggtext package)
# install.packages("ggtext") if not installed
library(ggtext)

p = p1 +
  geom_label(
    data = data.frame(x = 0.95, y = 0.05, label = auc_text),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    hjust = 1, vjust = 0,
    size = 6,
    family = "Times New Roman",
    label.size = 0.6,                  # border thickness
    label.padding = unit(0.7, "lines"),
    fill = "lightgrey",                    # soft background
    color = "black"
  ) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", face = "bold", size = 20),
    axis.title = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 17),
    axis.text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 16),
    # enable markdown so **ROC AUC** becomes bold
    plot.tag = element_markdown(),
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 18)
  )
ggsave(filename = "ROC S1 vals.png", plot = p, width = 6, height = 6)

p
```

# Figure S1

```{r warning=FALSE}
library(openxlsx)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(gridExtra)

data <- read.xlsx("data/sum_of_betas.xlsx")
data <- as.data.frame(data) %>% select(contains("CoCo"), contains("Vani")) 

col_names <- colnames(data)

data_long <- data %>% pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value")
# Transform the data
data_long <- data_long %>%
  # Split the Variable column
  separate(Variable, into = c("Type", "n", "p"), sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(n = as.numeric(n), p = as.numeric(p)) %>%
  mutate("(n,p)" = paste0("(n,p)=(", n, ",", p, ")")) %>%
  select(-c(n, p))

p = ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Value, fill = ifelse(grepl("CoCo", Type), "#E64B35FF", "#3C5488FF"))) + 
  geom_histogram(aes(y=after_stat(count/100)),bins = 20, color = "white") + 
  # facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "fixed", ncol = 2, nrow = 3,dir="v") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=0), linetype="dashed", color = "black") + 
  facet_grid(vars(`(n,p)`), vars(Type), scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Sum of the Regression Coefficients", y = "Frequency ") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-.8, .8, 0.2)) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 17),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )
p
ggsave(filename = "pic/hist of sumbetas.png", plot = p, width = 8, height = 9)
```
